## Review checklist / 自查

- [ ] The change is focused, with no unrelated source rollback or formatting churn.
- [ ] No game media, private history, secrets, personal cards or research dumps are included.
- [ ] Public status and English/Chinese docs remain accurate; unrun checks are labeled.
- [ ] Both build entrypoints are updated for product source-list changes, or not applicable.
- [ ] Builds and runtime/tests were not run concurrently, or execution was not applicable.
